entities.summary: Trenčín Electric Railway (TREŽ) is the name of the Slovakian 760 mm narrow-gauge rail transport line between Trenčianska Teplá and the town of Trenčianske Teplice with tram vehicles operating on the track. It is approximately 5.5 km long and consists of one inter-station section, while the only crossover called Kaňová was abolished in the second half of the 1990s.
